en.title: eau in beau (I drink / they drink)
en.summary: This item illustrates the Romanian diphthong eau as found in the verb form beau.

sections.title: The group eau
paragraphs: The group eau is spoken as the sound /e̯aw/. You can hear it in the word (beau) /be̯aw/, which means I drink. This letter combination makes only one sound in Romanian. It glides through three vowel parts in a single breath.

sections.title: How to say eau
paragraphs: Start with your lips spread slightly. Drop your jaw quickly to open the mouth. Then round your lips into a small circle at the very end. Keep your voice turned on without stopping the airflow. Put a hand on your throat to feel continuous vibration throughout the glide.

sections.title: Spelling of eau
paragraphs: The letters eau appear together in a single syllable as the sound /e̯aw/. You see this group often at the end of past tense verbs. For example, it appears in the verb (vedeau) /veˈde̯aw/.

sections.title: Mistakes to avoid
paragraphs: Do not read this group as three separate vowels. Do not say it like the French word beau or the English sound in boat. Glide smoothly from an e sound through an open vowel to a quick w sound.
